Here’s a list of well-known **office furniture brand websites** categorized by region and type (premium, mid-range, budget, and specialty):

---

### **🌍 Global & Premium Brands (High-End, Design-Focused)**
1. **Herman Miller** ([www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)) – Iconic ergonomic chairs (Aeron, Embody) and modern office systems.
2. **Steelcase** ([www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)) – Workplace solutions, ergonomic chairs (Gesture, Leap), and collaborative furniture.
3. **Knoll** ([www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)) – Designer furniture (Barcelona Chair, Saarinen Table) and modern office systems.
4. **Haworth** ([www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)) – Ergonomic chairs (Zody, Fern) and modular office solutions.
5. **Vitra** ([www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)) – Swiss design brand (Eames, Panton Chair) for high-end offices.
6. **Hay** ([www.hay.dk](https://www.hay.dk)) – Scandinavian design with office-friendly pieces.
7. **Fritz Hansen** ([www.fritzhansen.com](https://www.fritzhansen.com)) – Danish design (Egg Chair, Series 7).
8. **Humanscale** ([www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)) – Ergonomic chairs (Freedom, Diffrient Smart) and accessories.
9. **Okamura** ([www.okamura.com](https://www.okamura.com)) – Japanese brand with high-end ergonomic chairs (Contessa, ProFlex).
10. **Kinnarps** ([www.kinnarps.com](https://www.kinnarps.com)) – Scandinavian office furniture (Sweden-based).

---

### **🇺🇸 North America (Mid-Range & Commercial)**
11. **HON** ([www.hon.com](https://www.hon.com)) – Affordable, durable office furniture (part of HNI Corporation).
12. **Allsteel** ([www.allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com)) – Commercial-grade office systems (part of Steelcase).
13. **Teknion** ([www.teknion.com](https://www.teknion.com)) – Canadian brand with modern office solutions.
14. **Global Furniture Group** ([www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)) – Commercial and healthcare furniture.
15. **Kimball Office** ([www.kimballoffice.com](https://www.kimballoffice.com)) – Workplace solutions (part of Kimball International).
16. **National Office Furniture** ([www.nationalofficefurniture.com](https://www.nationalofficefurniture.com)) – Budget-friendly commercial furniture.
17. **Bush Furniture** ([www.bushfurniture.com](https://www.bushfurniture.com)) – Affordable home/office furniture (part of Bush Industries).
18. **Sauder** ([www.sauder.com](https://www.sauder.com)) – Budget-friendly home office furniture.
19. **IKEA** ([www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com)) – Affordable, modular office furniture (global).
20. **Wayfair** ([www.wayfair.com](https://www.wayfair.com)) – Online retailer with a wide range of office furniture brands.

---

### **🇪🇺 Europe (Design & Commercial)**
21. **Sedus** ([www.sedus.com](https://www.sedus.com)) – German ergonomic chairs and office systems.
22. **Wilkhahn** ([www.wilkhahn.com](https://www.wilkhahn.com)) – German design-focused office furniture.
23. **Vitra (Europe)** ([www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)) – Same as above, with EU distribution.
24. **Arper** ([www.arper.com](https://www.arper.com)) – Italian design (Catifa, Aston chairs).
25. **Cassina** ([www.cassina.com](https://www.cassina.com)) – Luxury Italian furniture (LC4 Chaise, LC2 Sofa).
26. **B&B Italia** ([www.bebitalia.com](https://www.bebitalia.com)) – High-end Italian office seating.
27. **Flokk** ([www.flokk.com](https://www.flokk.com)) – Scandinavian brand (HÅG, RH, Giroflex chairs).
28. **Koleksiyon** ([www.koleksiyon.com](https://www.koleksiyon.com)) – Turkish brand with modern office solutions.
29. **Nowy Styl** ([www.nowystyl.com](https://www.nowystyl.com)) – Polish brand with ergonomic chairs.
30. **Actiu** ([www.actiu.com](https://www.actiu.com)) – Spanish brand with innovative office furniture.

---

### **🇦🇺 Asia & Australia (Regional Brands)**
31. **Kokuyo** ([www.kokuyo.co.jp](https://www.kokuyo.co.jp)) – Japanese office furniture (ergonomic chairs, desks).
32. **Okamura (Asia)** ([www.okamura.com](https://www.okamura.com)) – Same as above, with Asian distribution.
33. **KI (Krueger International)** ([www.ki.com](https://www.ki.com)) – Global brand with strong presence in Asia.
34. **Zenith** ([www.zenith.com.au](https://www.zenith.com.au)) – Australian office furniture brand.
35. **Jardan** ([www.jardan.com.au](https://www.jardan.com.au)) – Australian design-focused furniture.
36. **Formway** ([www.formway.com](https://www.formway.com)) – New Zealand brand (Life Chair, Be Chair).
37. **Godrej Interio** ([www.godrejinterio.com](https://www.godrejinterio.com)) – Indian office furniture brand.
38. **Featherlite** ([www.featherlitefurniture.com](https://www.featherlitefurniture.com)) – Indian commercial furniture.
39. **UE Furniture** ([www.uefurniture.com](https://www.uefurniture.com)) – Chinese office furniture manufacturer.
40. **Sunon** ([www.sunon.com](https://www.sunon.com)) – Taiwanese ergonomic chair brand.

---

### **🛒 Online Retailers & Marketplaces (Multi-Brand)**
41. **Amazon** ([www.amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com)) – Wide selection of office furniture (search by brand).
42. **Wayfair** ([www.wayfair.com](https://www.wayfair.com)) – Sells multiple brands (HON, Bush, etc.).
43. **Office Depot/OfficeMax** ([www.officedepot.com](https://www.officedepot.com)) – Commercial and home office furniture.
44. **Staples** ([www.staples.com](https://www.staples.com)) – Office furniture and supplies.
45. **Uline** ([www.uline.com](https://www.uline.com)) – Bulk office furniture and supplies.
46. **Furniture At Work** ([www.furniture-work.co.uk](https://www.furniture-work.co.uk)) – UK-based office furniture retailer.
47. **Office Furniture Online** ([www.officefurnitureonline.co.uk](https://www.officefurnitureonline.co.uk)) – UK retailer.
48. **Made.com** ([www.made.com](https://www.made.com)) – Affordable design furniture (UK/EU).
49. **West Elm** ([www.westelm.com](https://www.westelm.com)) – Modern home/office furniture.
50. **CB2** ([www.cb2.com](https://www.cb2.com)) – Contemporary office furniture (part of Crate & Barrel).

---

### **🔍 Specialty & Niche Brands**
51. **Uplift Desk** ([www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)) – Standing desks.
52. **Fully** ([www.fully.com](https://www.fully.com)) – Standing desks and ergonomic chairs (Jarvis, Capisco).
53. **Autonomous** ([www.autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)) – Smart office furniture (standing desks, ergonomic chairs).
54. **Branch** ([www.branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com)) – Direct-to-consumer office furniture.
55. **FlexiSpot** ([www.flexispot.com](https://www.flexispot.com)) – Standing desks and ergonomic solutions.
56. **Secretlab** ([www.secretlab.co](https://www.secretlab.co)) – Gaming/office chairs.
57. **DXRacer** ([www.dxracer.com](https://www.dxracer.com)) – Gaming/office chairs.
58. **Ergohuman** ([www.ergohuman.com](https://www.ergohuman.com)) – Ergonomic chairs.
59. **SitOnIt** ([www.sitonit.net](https://www.sitonit.net)) – Commercial seating and desks.
60. **9to5 Seating** ([www.9to5seating.com](https://www.9to5seating.com)) – Ergonomic task chairs.

---

### **💡 Tips for Choosing Office Furniture**
- **Ergonomics:** Look for adjustable chairs (Herman Miller, Steelcase, Humanscale).
- **Budget:** IKEA, HON, and Wayfair offer affordable options.
- **Design:** Knoll, Vitra, and Hay for modern aesthetics.
- **Commercial Use:** Steelcase, Haworth, and Teknion for large offices.
- **Standing Desks:** Uplift, Fully, or Autonomous.

Would you like recommendations for a specific type of furniture (e.g., ergonomic chairs, standing desks, conference tables)?
